references.text: Priests shall distinguish between the holy and the common, between the unclean and the clean - the same theme of separating (לְהַבְדִּיל)
Command to distinguish between clean and unclean animals, a direct parallel to the content about distinguishing between edible and non-edible animals
Detailed list of clean and unclean animals that may and may not be eaten, parallel legislation to Leviticus 11
The priests shall teach the people to distinguish between holy and common, and between clean and unclean - the same terminology and concept
The priests shall teach the people the difference between holy and common, and between unclean and clean
Peter's vision concerning clean and unclean animals, where God declares that what He has cleansed should not be called unclean - New Testament fulfillment
Retelling of Peter's vision with unclean animals, showing how the distinction between clean and unclean takes on new meaning in the new covenant
